material_defects.summary: Compilation failure can satisfy maximum assurance because the clause tests compilation attempted rather than compilation succeeded.
A failed high/critical reproduction attempt can satisfy maximum assurance because the clause checks attempts rather than successful, integrity-validated reproduction.
Mandatory complementary fuzzer/formal engine presence is not enforced by default; an unavailable formal record can satisfy inventory.
The standalone scanner clause can pass without a Slither record when another scanner succeeds.
Model surface coverage credits supplied context to any successful response without proving substantive review of each surface.
Model quality measurement hashes are shape-validated but not resolved against passed benchmark artifacts.
verify-run reports a valid CLI profile-overridden run stale because it cannot reproduce the effective profile override hashes.
The empty-report benchmark vacuously passes semantic-coverage and safe-control subgates even though overall status is incomplete.
The release evidence validator manufactures declared traceability artifact names instead of proving emitted runtime artifacts.
The current release-gate report is stale, unbound to the evaluated commit, and records only eight of twelve gates passed.
Mutation support covers five of the eleven required classes and has no real end-to-end property kill evidence.
Reproduction identity evidence does not independently compare deployed runtime bytecode with the compiled audited source.
Rejected findings in the human-readable report omit the full per-finding evidence, verifier, falsifier, remediation, and uncertainty fields available elsewhere.
